label: REPLAY synthetic population on LOCAL ClickHouse in docker (laptop). Not ClickHouse Cloud, not native Guild evidence, not containment latency, not a production SLA.

environment.note: Queries issued sequentially from one Node process; OS page cache and ClickHouse mark/uncompressed caches were NOT dropped between runs, so warm samples are cache-warm repeated-shape workloads.

declaration.coldRunsPerClass: one run before warmups (first execution of the class after population insert; caches not dropped)

classes.a: conflict_check (whole-generation conflict/canonical extraction) and anchor_list (canonical selected-ALLOW anchors per manifest)
classes.b: anchor_all_candidates (one anchor, all candidates of one manifest)
classes.c: procedure = application evaluateGeneration over all anchors of one manifest; sample unit = one manifest (8 distinct manifests)
classes.d: oracle_extract (3 SELECTs reading raw rows/bindings/sessions back) and oracle_sweep (runOracle per manifest)

declaration.anchorSelectionForB: stratified deterministic: group = j mod 8, anchor index = ((j+2)*7919) mod anchors(group); all distinct from repeated cutoff queries
declaration.serverTimeSource: system.query_log QueryFinish filtered by exact issued query_ids (joined through bench_issued) after SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS; query_duration_ms is integer milliseconds, microsecond duration derived from query_start/event_time_microseconds

population.selection: selected candidates = all declared candidates of the 8 manifests; unit of count = distinct native identity of a verified-bound ALLOW in a complete session within (T-600s,T] and effective_from <= t <= cutoff
population.antiInflation: no cloned identical rows beyond declared exact redeliveries (same identity & content, new observation id); stored rows vs distinct canonical units reported above

procedure.serverQueryLog: not a single ClickHouse query (in-process or multi-query); see procedure_member classes for server time

anchorEvaluationsPerRun.definition: anchor_all_candidates queries incl. the capture-cutoff evaluation, per manifest, summed over the runs listed in perRun

procedure.note: wall time of evaluateGeneration() includes its in-process independent-oracle equality check (class oracle_sweep) and sequential queries

oracle_sweep.serverQueryLog: not a single ClickHouse query (in-process or multi-query); see procedure_member classes for server time

failures: oracle conflict keys must equal injected conflict keys

queryLog.note: Failed queries have no issued id returned by runNamed; they are counted via applicationErrorsCaught only.

limitations: Synthetic seeded replay population; no real fleet, customer events, attack accuracy or containment performance follows from it.
Local ClickHouse 25.8 in docker with limited container resources on a laptop; not Cloud, not multi-node, no replication.
Caches are not dropped; "cold" is only the first execution of a class after insertion and is not a true cold-cache measurement.
n is small (declared per class); p95 at n=20 is the 19th sorted value and has little tail precision; p95 at n=8 equals the maximum.
Sequential single-client execution; no concurrency or throughput claim.
The procedure wall time includes the in-process oracle equality check and the oracle runs on rows extracted from ClickHouse.
Allowances were chosen from realized peaks (parameter selection); expected answers come from the independent oracle, not from those peaks.
